narration: Your complete financial identity — Social Security number, bank accounts, credit history — is for sale online right now. The going price? Twelve dollars.
visual: Dark background with a red price tag SVG showing '$12' springing in from center. Above it: 'YOUR IDENTITY' header slides up. Below: three icons — SSN card, credit card, bank building — fade in.

narration: For twelve bucks, a stranger gets your name, address, SSN, and full credit history. Everything they need to open accounts in your name while you sleep.
visual: Light background. Three document cards spring in: an ID card with a person silhouette, an SSN card showing 'XXX-XX-1234', and a credit report. Red 'WHILE YOU SLEEP' badge appears.

narration: The average victim loses over eight thousand dollars and spends two hundred hours fixing the mess. That's five weeks of full-time work, just cleaning up someone else's crime.
visual: Dark background. A cracked piggy bank SVG with gold coins falling from the slot. Dollar counter animates up to $8,167. '200+ HOURS WASTED' slides in below.

narration: Here's the thing — there's a completely free move that blocks ninety percent of new-account fraud. Takes five minutes, and most people have literally never heard of it.
visual: Light background. Phone SVG with a shield and padlock appearing on screen. 'FREE' and '5 MIN' labels spring in on either side. Green 'ACTIVE' indicator on phone.

narration: It's called a credit freeze. You lock your file at all three bureaus — Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion. Lenders literally cannot see your credit to approve fake accounts.
visual: Dark background. Three red shield SVGs spring in labeled EQUIFAX, EXPERIAN, TRANSUNION. Padlocks snap onto each one sequentially. A green checkmark circle appears below.

narration: Only one in four adults has done this. Search 'freeze credit Equifax' right now — it's free, it's instant, and it's the easiest eight thousand dollars you'll ever protect.
visual: Light background. Phone centered showing a 'FREEZE YOUR CREDIT' button and '100% FREE' badge. '75%' stat badge in red. Three bureau shield icons appear below. Strong CTA layout.
